'''Endelaan''' was a lost [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that the [[Nebula (organization)|Nebula]] organization believed would bring about the destruction of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] if discovered. The crew of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Spiral Dancer]]'' was sent to find it.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
